name: Vercel AI Gateway
note: Quota only, and a balance rather than a meter: the credits endpoint states what is left and never what a full tank was, so there is nothing honest to fill a bar against. The key comes from AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY — an app launched from Finder inherits no shell, so set it in ~/.antarium/harnesses/vercel-gateway.json as a textFile credential if the environment variable is not visible.

compatibility.note: Mapping is fixture-verified against the published response shape; the numbers themselves are unconfirmed against a live account.

quota.setupHint: Set AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY from your Vercel AI Gateway settings.
